title: Wing Arms: Kareinaru Gekitsuiou
native_title: ウイング・アームズ ～華麗なる撃墜王～
overview:
Orders to sortie!! Stop the invasion of the enemy army "Avalon"!!

After the summer of 1945, a group of arms makers called Avalon, which profited from the war, sets out to keep it going by turning captured Axis and Allied planes against the military bases of the world's nations. A squadron of former enemies gathers aboard the aircraft carrier Endeavor to stop them.

In this arcade-style air combat game, pick one of seven real World War II fighter planes and fly six seek-and-destroy missions against enemy aircraft, warships and bases. Each mission begins with a radio briefing from the carrier's admiral. Shoot with your machine gun - keep it from overheating - and fire your limited supply of missiles, using the radar, compass and target arrows to find your way.

- 1 player
- Switch between three viewpoints
- Mission Stick support

出撃命令!!
敵軍「アヴァロン」の侵略行為を阻止せよ!!
